name: Ensnared
source:
A mysterious alchemical accident occurs, and suddenly your whole village slowly turns into plants! 

Entangled is an apothecary-themed visual novel where you can talk to and potentially date people that become plants developed during the 2023 Global Game Jam.

[From [url=https://creepy-vine.itch.io/ensnared]Itch.io[/url]]
